scene.title: 求职面试
scene.subtitle: A job interview
scene.description: 从开场到反问,一整套面试英语:介绍背景、讲优势、答动机、应对缺点/离职、反问面试官。
learn: 回答难题(缺点/离职原因)

entry.zh: 我对这个职位很感兴趣。

entry.en: I look forward to hearing from you.

beginner.en: Thank you for meeting with me today.
beginner.zh: 谢谢您今天抽时间见我。

beginner.en: I have three years of experience in marketing.
beginner.zh: 我有三年市场营销的经验。

beginner.en: I'm a quick learner and a team player.
beginner.zh: 我学得快，也善于团队合作。

beginner.en: I applied because I really want to grow here.
beginner.zh: 我来应聘是因为很想在这里成长。

beginner.en: My biggest strength is my attention to detail.
beginner.zh: 我最大的优势是注重细节。

beginner.en: When can I expect to hear back from you?
beginner.zh: 我大概什么时候能收到您的回复？

intermediate.en: Thanks for taking the time to meet with me today.
intermediate.zh: 谢谢您今天抽时间见我。

intermediate.en: In my current role, I manage a team of five.
intermediate.zh: 在目前的岗位上，我带一个五人的团队。

intermediate.en: I'd say my strongest skill is problem-solving.
intermediate.zh: 我认为我最强的技能是解决问题。

intermediate.en: I'm really drawn to your company's focus on innovation.
intermediate.zh: 我很欣赏贵公司对创新的重视。

intermediate.en: Could you tell me more about the team I'd be working with?
intermediate.zh: 能多讲讲我将合作的团队吗？

intermediate.en: What does success look like in this position?
intermediate.zh: 在这个岗位上，怎样算做得出色？

advanced.en: I appreciate you walking me through the role in such detail.
advanced.zh: 谢谢您这么详细地介绍这个岗位。

advanced.en: I left my last position because I was looking for a bigger challenge.
advanced.zh: 我离开上一份工作，是想寻求更大的挑战。

advanced.en: If I had to name a weakness, I'd say I can be a bit of a perfectionist.
advanced.zh: 要说缺点的话，我有点完美主义。

advanced.en: I'm confident I could add value from day one.
advanced.zh: 我有信心从第一天起就能创造价值。

advanced.en: How would you describe the company culture here?
advanced.zh: 您会怎么形容这里的公司文化？

advanced.en: Is there anything about my background you'd like me to expand on?
advanced.zh: 关于我的背景，有什么需要我进一步说明的吗？
